new_module: service/deess.py — LPC-based click/pop detection with masked-companion follow-up detection, LSAR (Vaseghi & Rayner / Godsill & Rayner) reconstruction with ring-tail envelope extension and energy-envelope matching, + split-band de-essing on Clean dialogue only
panel_smoke: passed, including De-click & de-ess dialogue checkbox default-off state (flipped after real-world artifacting reports; see status below) and Click/pop report aggregation
status: de-click/de-ess turned OFF by default (was on-by-default earlier in 0.6.1) after the user reported it introduced audible artifacting on other clips beyond the specific pop it was validated against. Feature/code/tests are intact and remain available as an opt-in checkbox / API setting; not removed. Root cause of the artifacting on those other clips has not yet been diagnosed -- follow-up needed before re-enabling by default. Also added service/app.py DSP_CODE_SHA256 (hash of deess.py+audio.py bytes) into the job cache fingerprint, since a purely internal DSP fix with no settings/API change was found to leave stale pre-fix job results eligible for cache reuse.
real_world_validation: tuned and re-validated against a real recorded mic pop (clip-002-dialogue.wav, ~12.1s) across several rounds: (1) MAX_RUN_MS/MERGE_GAP_MS/LSAR resolved the sharp onset but left an audible decaying ~800Hz resonance tail unrepaired (low LPC residual, since it's smooth/predictable) -- fixed with ring-tail energy-envelope extension (_extend_for_ring), dropping the peak in the affected region from 0.600 to ~0.09; (2) spectrogram diff analysis confirmed full-spectrum click removal but the user still heard a distinct click/tick at the very start of the repair -- traced to the LSAR AR model's single fit across a quiet-before/louder-after context boundary landing on a fill quieter than either side rather than continuing the real rising trend (before/after RMS ratio ~1.25x on this file); fixed with post-solve envelope-matching (_match_envelope) that rescales the AR fit's own waveform shape to bridge the real levels on each side, gated by ENVELOPE_MISMATCH_RATIO so stationary/symmetric gaps are left untouched. Also added _find_masked_companions: a confirmed click's own residual can inflate the 20ms MAD block it shares with following dialogue enough to hide a smaller nearby click from the primary threshold; a bounded local-baseline follow-up scan (SECONDARY_MAD_MULTIPLIER/SECONDARY_SEARCH_MS/SECONDARY_MAX_RUN_MS) catches these without lowering detection sensitivity file-wide. User confirmed after the envelope-matching fix that the click/tick was resolved.
model_comparison_real_audio: tests/test_deess_real_audio.py (3 tests) runs the production pipeline against two baseline 'models' on the same real clip-002-dialogue_ORIGINAL_full.wav fixture (skips if the fixture is absent): naive_mad_linear (generic amplitude/MAD threshold + linear fill, representative of simple open-source declickers -- @audio/denoise-declick npm pkg, 0x07dc/declicker JUCE plugin and oximedia-audio Rust crate were researched as real candidates; none were clearly better than what's already here, see README/chat history) and ablated_lpc_linear (this project's own pre-LSAR detector+linear-fill 'v1'). Measured on the fixture: production reduces the real pop's peak from 0.600 to 0.231 vs 0.450 for both baselines, and leaves lower post-repair LPC-residual energy than either. Also measured and asserted as a ceiling: production repairs 27 locations file-wide on this one real ~15s clip and only 1 is the actual pop -- the other 26 are short (often sub-ms) repairs scattered across ordinary dialogue, several in tight 2-5-repair bursts within a few tens of ms of the same syllable (see clusters in validation/pop-removal-listen/cluster*_ORIGINAL_realtime.wav / cluster*_PRODUCTION_realtime.wav, real-time speed, not slowed down). This is the concrete, measured version of the 'artifacting on other clips' report the feature was turned off for; naive_mad_linear is far worse on this axis (198 flagged locations) so switching detectors is not the fix -- the LPC-based detector's own false-positive rate on fast consonant/plosive content needs investigating before re-enabling by default.
